author: Kellie
quote: The training was amazing, actually the best session I've ever had. Learned so much and went away with stuff we can use, really great. 110% satisfied, would like Harvey and Ernesto again.

author: Chloe

author: Tanya

author: Alison

author: Baden

author: Jan

author: Shaina
